### Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or opportunity. (e.g. "I find it hard to track supersets during physical workouts...")

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how this fits into DragonQuest's RPG training philosophy (Power, Focus, Discipline, Mind, Energy).

### Affected Systems
- [ ] Training Chamber (Timer / Workout / Breathing)
- [ ] Quests & Habits (Board / Routines / Tasks)
- [ ] Progression & Game Engine (XP / Levels / Attributes / Milestones)
- [ ] Local Database & Migrations (SQLite / Drizzle)
- [ ] Cloud Sync & Supabase (Auth / RLS / Sync Engine)
- [ ] Design System & UI (Tokens / Components / Animations)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup sketches, or references here.
